rules.statement: In a changelog entry, cite a pull request or issue as a full Markdown link such as `([owner/repo#N](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/N))`, not as plain `owner/repo#N` shorthand.
rules.why: GitHub doesn't auto-link that shorthand in a committed Markdown file, so people reading CHANGELOG.md raw, on nuget.org or in other tools can't follow the reference.
rules.check: Look at new or changed CHANGELOG.md entries for `owner/repo#N` or `#N` references that aren't wrapped in a Markdown link to the GitHub URL. Use `/pull/N` for pull requests.
